# Write-free e2e: --spec - reads Project Spec from stdin.

# validate from stdin (examples/minimal-cli.toml body).
stdin examples/minimal-cli.toml
exec foundry validate --spec -
stdout 'validate: ok'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .

# plan from stdin.
stdin examples/minimal-cli.toml
exec foundry plan --spec -
stdout 'plan:'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .

# plan JSON from stdin — source records stdin.
stdin examples/minimal-cli.toml
exec foundry plan --spec - --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
stdout '"source":"stdin"'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_stdin.json
dump_digest plan_stdin.json

# Invalid body on stdin → exact error id.
stdin examples/invalid-unknown-field.toml
! exec foundry validate --spec -
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unknown_field

# Empty stdin should fail with a stable spec.* id.
stdin empty.txt
! exec foundry validate --spec -
stderr 'spec.invalid_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.invalid_field

-- empty.txt --
